justification: Adds two automated checks to pre-push hook and CI. No production code changes. No DB, no API, no user-facing changes.

pre_impl.existing_data: No DB interaction. Scans source files only via git diff.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If git diff fails (detached HEAD, shallow clone), liability check returns 0 and passes silently. Acceptable -- CI has fetch-depth 0.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Only scans NEW lines in diff. Existing code not re-scanned.

functions.name: get_diff_added_lines
functions.input: base branch name string from git diff command
functions.output: dict mapping filepath to list of added line tuples
functions.if_none: returns empty dict, check passes with zero findings

values.if_missing: script would fail at import with NameError

break_it.scenario: Liability term in a comment or import line flagged as false positive
break_it.what_happens: Push blocked unnecessarily, developer frustrated by false positive
break_it.how: EXCLUDE_PATTERNS list at line 42 filters comments, imports, variable names, logger calls

break_it.scenario: Git diff command fails on shallow clone in CI environment
break_it.what_happens: get_diff_added_lines returns empty dict, check passes silently with no findings
break_it.how: CI workflow uses fetch-depth 0 for full history. Pre-push always has full clone.

break_it.scenario: New liability term added to existing file but only in unchanged line content
break_it.what_happens: Term not caught because only diff-added lines are scanned
break_it.how: By design -- existing code was reviewed in language-audit-2026-05-18. Only new code needs checking.

post_merge.manual_verify: Run git config core.hooksPath .githooks in existing clones to get updated pre-push hook
